engineering_target_envelope.threshold: both backends satisfy every one-sided engineering target within 10%

quadratic_flux_target.threshold: both backends have quadratic flux <= 1e-05 with 10% allowance

tight_absolute_engineering_feasibility.threshold: both backends satisfy every physical violation allowance

cpu.message: STOP: TOTAL NO. OF ITERATIONS REACHED LIMIT

gpu.message: STOP: TOTAL NO. OF ITERATIONS REACHED LIMIT

cpu.message: inner stationarity safeguard stopped outer updates before penalty or multiplier escalation

gpu.message: inner stationarity safeguard stopped outer updates before penalty or multiplier escalation

flux_refinement.checkpoint_policy: minimum quadratic flux among accepted iterates satisfying all engineering target-envelope residuals; otherwise minimum residual infinity norm then flux

continuation.update_condition: inner first-order acceptance and scaled AL progress

residual_scaling.formula: family_l2: max(sqrt(family_count), initial_family_l2); one shared attenuation scale per family

validation_policy.engineering_target_semantics: minimum-distance measurements may be at most the stated fraction below target; maximum curvature measurements may be at most the stated fraction above target
validation_policy.gradient_semantics: large coil-optimization gradients are expected and are recorded as optimizer diagnostics, not scientific validation vetoes
validation_policy.name: physical_quantity_target_envelope
validation_policy.normalized_normal_field_semantics: B dot n over abs(B) has ideal target zero, for which percentage error is undefined; retain mean, RMS, and maximum absolute values and report CPU/GPU agreement as an independent technical gate
validation_policy.quadratic_flux_semantics: quadratic flux is a one-sided upper target with the same relative allowance as the engineering targets
validation_policy.scientific_validation_rule: scientifically_validated is determined exclusively by the physical engineering target envelope and explicit quadratic-flux target, not by raw gradient magnitude or CPU/GPU path agreement
validation_policy.strict_residual_semantics: strict local-AL residual and feasibility tolerances diagnose solver convergence but do not override physical target validation
